name: GetCertificateMetadata
label: Get AWS Certificate Manager Certificate Metadata
description: Retrieves metadata for an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate using the DescribeCertificate API.

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: CertificateArn
fields.label: Certificate ARN
fields.description: The ARN of the AWS Certificate Manager certificate to retrieve metadata for (e.g., arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/...).

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the certificate is located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: Metadata
fields.label: Certificate Metadata
fields.description: Structured metadata about the certificate (domain, status, expiration, etc.).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS Certificate Manager.
